Sana Pandey
Senior Business Development Manager | Delhi NCR
sana.pandey928@example.com | +91 9113519415

Seasoned sales professional focused on strategic B2B growth, key account expansion, and cross-functional collaboration. Proven track record driving revenue through targeted enterprise deals, pipeline management in Salesforce, and operational improvements using Agile practices. Not open to relocation; looking for roles in Delhi NCR only. Notice period: 30 days.

Experience

UrbanPantry — Nov 2021 - Present
Senior Business Development Manager (Hybrid)
- Managed a portfolio of 25+ enterprise and mid-market accounts using Key Account Management practices, increasing account retention by 18% and expanding revenue from existing clients by 27% year-over-year.
- Led B2B Sales initiatives targeting corporate catering and employee meal programs, closing deals worth INR 3.2M ARR in FY2023 and contributing to a 22% lift in quarterly bookings.
- Owned Salesforce pipeline hygiene and forecasting; improved conversion rate from qualified lead to closed-won by 14% through standardized CRM processes and weekly deal reviews.
- Collaborated with product and operations using Agile ceremonies and Jira to launch a dedicated corporate ordering workflow, reducing onboarding time for new B2B clients by 35%.

CartNest — Sep 2017 - Oct 2021
Account Executive (Onsite)
- Drove B2B Sales efforts across SMB and mid-market segments, consistently achieving 110-130% of quarterly quota and generating INR 2.1M in new business in 2020.
- Maintained Salesforce records for a book of 80+ prospects and customers, shortening sales cycle by 20% via targeted outreach sequences and CRM segmentation.
- Negotiation lead on contracts with channel partners and corporate buyers, securing multi-quarter agreements that increased average deal size by 24%.
- Partnered with product and delivery teams in Agile sprints, logging requirements in Jira and using Git-tracked collateral to streamline integrations for top 10 accounts.

Projects

- Corporate Catering Onboarding Playbook — Developed a repeatable onboarding process for enterprise clients integrating Salesforce-driven checklists and Jira tasks; reduced time-to-first-order from 12 days to 8 days.
- Channel Partner Enablement Kit — Created sales collateral and contract templates stored in Git that standardized negotiations and improved close rates with channel partners by 15%.

Skills
B2B Sales | Salesforce | Negotiation
Key Account Management | Agile | Jira | Git
